description: China, Macao Special Administrative Region: Road Surface Data is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by HeiGIT (Heidelberg Institute for Geoinformation Technology). This dataset provides detailed information on road surfaces from OpenStreetMap (OSM), distinguishing between paved and unpaved roads across the region. Surface classification is derived using a hybrid deep learning approach. For methodological details, see: Recently, we also published a new country-level dataset based on PlanetScope satellite imagery with near-complete coverage of all arterial roads. Coverage: Macao. The portal files it under the publisher HeiGIT (Heidelberg Institute for Geoinformation Technology). Its tags are development, humanitarian access, indicators, logistics, openstreetmap. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE. The portal shows 2026-06-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
